text: {"name":"wlc_phy_chanspec_set","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Populates a per-band, per-unit channel-specification entry in a large configuration table, selecting a mode-dependent payload layout (random nonce, copied source fields, or a 16-byte block) and marking the slot valid.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"v3":"band","v4":"unit_idx","v5":"table_base","v6":"chanspec_entry","v7":"entry_offset","v8":"sub_cfg_ptr","a2":"chanspec_value"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"band index (uint8)"},{"offset":40,"meaning":"mode/phy type (uint8)"},{"offset":41,"meaning":"unit/MAC-core index (uint8)"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"extra config byte copied to entry+596"},{"offset":24,"meaning":"uint32 copied to entry+560 (mode 1)"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"uint32 copied to entry+564 (mode 1)"},{"offset":32,"meaning":"uint32 copied to entry+568 (mode 1)"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"uint32 copied to entry+572 (mode 1)"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"16-byte block copied to entry+560 (mode 5) / uint64 at entry+580"},{"offset":576,"meaning":"mode (uint8)"},{"offset":577,"meaning":"band (uint8)"},{"offset":578,"meaning":"chanspec parameter (uint8, from a2)"},{"offset":579,"meaning":"valid flag (uint8)"},{"offset":480,"meaning":"72-byte sub-configuration zeroed and conditionally populated"},{"offset":552,"meaning":"nonce / random or copied 8-byte value (uint64)"},{"offset":560,"meaning":"16-byte payload field (copied in modes 1/5)"},{"offset":580,"meaning":"16-byte config copied from source uint64 fields"},{"offset":596,"meaning":"auxiliary byte copied from source offset 4"},{"offset":1200,"meaning":"pointer to sub-config (parent, mode != 5)"},{"offset":1204,"meaning":"pointer to sub-config (parent, mode == 5)"}]}
